qrLogin.linkStep1: Open a Matrix app on the new device, for example Element X.
qrLogin.linkStep2: Choose to sign in with a QR code.
qrLogin.signInStep1: Open a Matrix app that can link devices on a device where you're already signed in, for example Element X.
qrLogin.signInStep2: Go to its device settings and choose to link a new device.
qrLogin.enterCode: Enter the 2-digit code shown on the new device.
qrLogin.codeMismatch: That code doesn't match. Check the new device and try again.
qrLogin.showCode: Enter this code on your other device:
qrLogin.approveInBrowser: Approve the new device on your account page that just opened.
qrLogin.linkDone: The new device is signed in and verified.
qrLogin.failExpired: The sign-in took too long and expired. Please start again.
qrLogin.failInsecure: The connection couldn't be secured. Please start again.
qrLogin.failUnsupported: Your homeserver doesn't support signing in with a QR code.
qrLogin.failAlreadySignedIn: That device is already signed in.
qrLogin.failGeneric: Signing in with the QR code failed. Please try again.
